trust_decision.summary: Request::getMethod() decides the effective HTTP method and unconditionally trusts the client-supplied X-HTTP-Method-Override header or _method request variable (from $_REQUEST: query, body or cookie) over the server's REQUEST_METHOD, regardless of the real verb; the router and middleware selection then run on that value.

landing_point.why: The only place that reads HTTP_X_HTTP_METHOD_OVERRIDE / _method; a summary saying 'method override enabled by default' leads straight to it.
